summary: Discover relayed message closes from changed keys and remote mark events instead of recurring fleet scans

replay.detail: No claim replay. Local discovery candidates bootstrap once from retained open selector recipients, then maintain only changed message, recipient and host keys.

schema.detail: Adds member-local durable discovery work/candidate/bootstrap/read-job tables, durable pending terminal-close evidence, indexed declared-member host lookup, and a retained scope-event journal for remote held-message and recipient-ownership changes. These tables stay outside replication and canonical digests.

rules.detail: No admission, claim or digest rule change. Terminal closes still require the declared recipient host's authenticated held answer and receipt. Discovery remains daemon-owned and independent of GET side effects. Read jobs are acknowledged only after successful answers and durable close admission; network failures get explicit retry deadlines. Local writer failures preserve terminal evidence across restart and wait for actual committed writer recovery, without a retry timer.

compatibility.detail: Advertises message_mark_events:1 and adds an authenticated seat-freshness long-poll operation. Existing message-mark reads retain their wire shape. Capable peers use event subscriptions; older peers retain a scoped compatibility schedule over only their indexed pending messages. Upgrading a peer removes its compatibility schedule. Remove the arm after all active relay hosts advertise the feature and legacy_peer_discovery_passes remains zero.

downtime.detail: Normal restart. An initial subscription, restart or retained-event gap reconciles only that host's existing candidates. Idle transport keepalives do no discovery or answer rebuilding.

manual.detail: No manual migration. /v1/performance exposes relayed_close_work discovery_passes, candidate_messages, remote_event_pages, remote_changed_messages and legacy_peer_discovery_passes. Unchanged capable peers add zero discovery passes.

recovery.detail: An earlier binary ignores the additive local work and event tables and resumes its previous maintenance behavior. Existing relayed close evidence remains readable.
